name: Ninja: ShadowBlade
detailed_description:
Ninja: ShadowBlade Fury

The Maze is Alive. Can You Survive?

Two powerful sorcerers control the maze and move the very walls around you. As they reshape the maze, not only new paths open but also new dangers emerge. Every wall that disappears can give way to Fire spirits and zombie ninjas. They roam the maze pathways, hunting. Armed with the an ancient relic - the “Shadow Blade”, your mission is to find and kill the sorcerers who control this moving maze.

The Moving Maze

Every few seconds, the maze shift—some walls disappear, new ones emerge. Enemies may spawn where the walls once stood. The maze may even try to trap you within itself.

Enemies in the Dark

  • Fire Spirits – Fast and unpredictable, they will harm you if they touch you.

  • Zombie Ninjas – These ninjas are controlled by the sorcerers, they patrol the maze’s narrow corridors and prey on all living things.

  • The Sorcerers – Your ultimate targets.

The Shadow Blade

Can you wield the Shadow Blade, an ancient powerful sword forged in the void from pure darkness, to defeat the sorcerers.

The game Features:

Dynamic Maze Gameplay – Each maze unique and constant shifting of the walls means you have to keep searching different paths to reach the sorcerers.
Fighting Mechanics – Hack and Slash past your enemies with the help of your Shadow Blade or try to sneak past them.
Random Enemy Spawns – Enemies appear anywhere randomly as the maze walls keep changing.

Do you have what it takes to outsmart and defeat the sorcerers while staying alive or will you become lost in the maze’s shifting walls?

Wishlist now to take on this ninja challenge!

short_description: In this survival, hack and slash 2D action-platformer game, you are a ninja wielding the ancient but powerful ShadowBlade. You must hunt two powerful sorcerers who control a shifting maze & kill them to escape. But beware—every vanished wall may spawn deadly foes like fire spirits & zombie ninjas.
